name: alert_id
description: Unique UUID primary key of the operational risk alert

name: asset_class
description: Asset class classification (EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, CRYPTO, ETF)

name: severity
description: Alert severity level: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

name: metric_name
description: Quantitative metric evaluated during anomaly detection

name: threshold_value
description: Configured threshold value that was breached

name: event_timestamp
description: Timestamp of underlying trigger market event

name: created_at
description: Timestamp when alert record was written to Cloud SQL

name: status
description: Operational alert resolution status (ACTIVE, ACKNOWLEDGED, RESOLVED, DISMISSED)

name: payload_json
description: Diagnostic JSON payload string with contextual parameters
